fusions.name: Cave Shriek
fusions.desc: You shriek into the rock ahead, dealing 3 damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles ahead, with a 25% chance to leave each one [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Stalactite Drop
fusions.desc: Brings a spike of cave stone down on an enemy at or below 25% health, dealing 26 damage.

fusions.name: Roost Overhead
fusions.desc: You flit up onto the rock overhead, landing 2 tiles away; for 3 seconds blows deal no damage to you and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Sunless Hide
fusions.desc: At night, your armour rises by 12%. You gain +4% dodge chance at all times.
